offending_extra_words: (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent)
content, data or materials provided by Licensee to Licensor
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are present in operative text: two-way structure with Vendor defence/indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus notice/control/cooperation mechanics, and the Customer indemnity narrowed to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

Fallback is incomplete (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3x annual fees super-cap), but that is immaterial because the locked preferred level is satisfied and the two levels must not be mixed.

Minimality fails: the insertion adds 'hold harmless' language and indemnitees (directors, officers, employees, agents) beyond Customer and affiliates, and settlement-consent mechanics beyond the preferred notice/control/cooperation trio.

Minimality also fails on the two replacements, which rewrite nearly the whole sub-clauses (changed-character ratios 0.875 and 0.862 against the 0.600 limit) instead of anchoring larger unchanged spans.

Intent is preserved: Article XIII and unrelated terms remain effective, defined terms (Licensed Technology, Documentation, Confidential Information) are used as defined, and the Article XIII carve-out is necessary to prevent the new indemnity being nullified by the express infringement disclaimer.
